liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Best Bassist Award - Phil Lesh**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Best Album Award - In the Dark**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Best Drummer Award - Mickey Hart & Bill Kreutzmann**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Best Guitarist Award - Jerry Garcia**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Musician of the Year Award - Jerry Garcia**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **Mickey Hart & Friends Jam Session**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- **announcers & tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [6]
- **Long Tall Sally (2)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-03-12.138189.bammies.fm.flac1644** (recommended): FM broadcast; 10 songs; 57 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1988-03-12.156441.dsbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 3 songs; 29 min [2]

## Around the show

- Listener says a super jam was rumored among fans for some time beforehand [3]
- Jerry gives two humble, eloquent acceptance speeches; Bill Graham presents him the Musician of the Year award [5]
- A big-band house band plays Touch of Grey after each Grateful Dead award [5]
- Show was the 11th annual Bay Area Music Awards (Bammies); finale jam joined the Dead with Huey Lewis and the News [1]
- Jam lineup: Lesh and Mario Cipollina on bass, Weir in tuxedo, Garcia in brown sport coat, Chris Hayes on guitar [1]
- Brent Mydland and Merl Saunders shared one organ; Johnny Colla played sax, Sean Hopper keyboards, three drummers including Billy Gibson [1]
- Considered among the strongest post-Pigpen versions of Lovelight [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-03-12.138189.bammies.fm.flac1644**: taped by DL; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Source: KFOG-FM > Cassette (compilation tape of GD-related highlights, marked 3rd Gen) kindly provided from the collection of DL; [1]
- **gd1988-03-12.156441.dsbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 13, 2022; source: SBD > DAT > PCM [2]
